scope: Switch between email accounts from the folder list or the email menu, and remove an account you no longer want.

topics.title: Choose an account, then a folder
details: With more than one email account, press Control+Y or say Go to folder. Companion lists your accounts first.
Choose one with the arrow keys and Enter, or say its number or name. Then you hear that account's folders.
Press Escape to go back one step.

topics.title: Remove an email account
details: Say Remove email account, or press Alt, 6, 4 in email. Choose the account, then say yes.
Your email stays with your email service. Companion just stops using that account.
Nothing is removed unless you say yes. Pressing Enter alone means no.

topics.title: Email menu
details: Switch account in the email menu now lists your accounts. Choose one to open its inbox.
The email menu has a new Remove account item.

topics.title: Folder list
details: Escape now closes the folder list and says nothing was changed. Before, it read the whole email help.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
